import subprocess, sys
ok = True
for a in (['mcp', '--automation-read-root', sys.argv[2], '--automation-write-root', sys.argv[3]], ['mcp', '--automation-write-root', sys.argv[3]], ['--automation-read-root', sys.argv[2], 'mcp']):
    r = subprocess.run([sys.argv[1]] + a, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, capture_output=True, timeout=30)
    err = (r.stderr.decode('utf-8', 'replace').strip().splitlines() or [''])[0]
    print('EXIT', r.returncode, 'INIT' if r.stdout.strip() else 'NOINIT', err)
    ok = ok and r.returncode == 2 and not r.stdout.strip()
print('ROOT_FLAGS_REJECTED' if ok else 'ROOT_FLAGS_ACCEPTED')
